text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘The Lion and the Mouse’ (शेर और चूहा)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘The Lion and the Mouse’ (Sher aur chooha). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘The Lion and the Mouse’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘forest’ मतलब जंगल। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘forest’ matlab jungle. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘forest’ means जंगल. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘net’ मतलब जाल। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘net’ matlab jaal. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘net’ means जाल. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘free’ मतलब आज़ाद। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘free’ matlab aazaad. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘free’ means आज़ाद. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: A lion was sleeping in the forest.
A small mouse ran over his nose.
The lion woke up and caught the mouse.
"Please let me go," said the mouse.
The lion laughed, but he let the mouse go.
After some days, the lion was caught in a hunter's net.
The mouse came and cut the net with his sharp teeth.
Small friends can be big helpers.

question.en: How did the mouse cut the net?
